text:
marco.docs: Quick note 1: I'm prepping a small migration PR to standardize the function/tool-calling + structured-output examples. Targets: canonical invoice + intent examples, add a compact envelope for mobile/low-bandwidth, and a brief guardrails checklist. Will push the first commit in ~45m.

lina.eng: Thanks. Can you include the compact `schema_ref` approach so the docs don't inline large schemas? I can wire up the parser harness to validate the examples.

marco.docs: Yes 100%. Plan: 1) move canonical schemas to /docs/schemas/{invoice,user_intent}.json; 2) show full-envelope and compact `schema_ref` examples; 3) short consumer CI snippet showing validator fallback; 4) fix two broken anchors under parsing patterns.

devex-anna: I'll update the TS + Python SDK snippets to use the new `structured_output` param shape. Example compact envelope I intend to add:
```json
{"tool_call": {"name":"get_invoice","arguments": {"id":"INV-987"}}, "structured_output": {"schema_ref": "/docs/schemas/invoice.json"}}
```

lina.eng: FYI the runtime normalizes numbers (no trailing .0) and collapses single-item arrays unless explicitly `minItems:1`. I'll run a quick batch and paste observed outputs so examples match reality.

marco.docs: Good catch. Add an "observed vs expected" list in the PR if you see deviations. Also plan to include a tiny streaming note for tool-calls that emit partial chunks.

qa-bot: Please ensure docs-lint passes. Suggested command for reviewers: `make docs-lint && ./tools/snippet-check docs/structured-output`.

marco.docs: Yep. I'll run lint locally before opening. docs-bot: Draft PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4601 by marco.docs

devex-anna: Assign me and lina as reviewers. I'll push snippet updates after the first commit lands.

lina.eng: I'll paste harness outputs in a follow-up comment. Also adding a short "gotchas" bullet about nullable arrays and `oneOf` ambiguity (support tickets said this confuses users).

marco.docs: Targeting merge by next Wed EOD if CI is clean. If anyone wants to take a piece, say so here and I'll split the work.

devex-anna: I'll take SDK snippet edits.

marco.docs: Thanks all 70. Will ping once the PR is live with the first commit.
